text: For rolling terrain, athlete and coach agreed to maintain steady endurance effort on climbs without surging, guided by conversational breathing and comfortable cadence.
For exposed headwinds, agreed to use a lower bar position and start snacks earlier to preserve final-hour energy, while monitoring hand and shoulder comfort as volume increases.
Mild leg heaviness on day two of back-to-back rides cleared after 20 minutes of easy spinning, so the plan remains unchanged; agreed to shorten day two if heaviness ever persists beyond 30 minutes.
For rides over two hours, agreed on one bottle per hour, food every 30 minutes, and a larger breakfast before sustained climbing, with the routine first practiced on easy rides.
Recovery spins will start from the park side of town because fewer junctions support genuinely easy riding; athlete and coach agreed to protect easy days even when the schedule is busy.
